title: Bug Hunt: Multi-Byte Sensor Packet Endianness Bugs
description:
Sensors and radio modules often mix endianness conventions across different fields in the same telemetry packet.

### Packet Specification:
- Bytes [0..1]: Sensor ID in **Little Endian**
- Bytes [2..5]: Pressure (Pa) in **Big Endian**
- Bytes [6..7]: Status Flags in **Big Endian**

### Requirements:
Implement `parse_sensor_packet_fixed` resolving all endianness mismatches.
hint: Pay close attention to whether each individual field is specified as Little Endian or Big Endian in the hardware datasheet.
